en.title: Keanu Reeves in Talks for New Lego Movie: What We Know
en.summary: The beloved actor is reportedly in negotiations to star in a new Lego film from Universal, blending live-action and animation. This project could see Reeves stepping into a brand-new plastic world.
en.body:
Get ready for more brick-based adventures, because **Keanu Reeves** is reportedly in talks to star in a new **Lego** movie. The project, slated for a 2026 release, is a hybrid live-action and animated feature set to be helmed by **Josh Cooley**, the writer and director behind **Toy Story 4**. This marks the first film under a new deal between Universal Pictures and The Lego Group, aiming to bring three live-action films based on the iconic building blocks to the big screen.

Reeves, who recently reprised his role as daredevil Duke Caboom in *Toy Story 5*, seems to be embracing the world of toys on screen. While details about his potential character are scarce, sources indicate the film would revolve around him, regardless of whether he appears as a minifigure or in live-action form. The studio is reportedly keen on making Reeves the centerpiece of this new Lego cinematic universe. His involvement is still in negotiation, but the actor is reportedly warming to the idea, fueling speculation about the kind of role he might play – perhaps a stoic action hero reminiscent of John Wick, or something entirely new.

## A New Era for Lego on Screen

This new venture signifies a fresh chapter for Lego films, which previously found massive success under Warner Bros. with hits like *The Lego Movie* and its sequels. Universal's acquisition of the film rights promises a different approach, and the inclusion of live-action elements alongside animation opens up exciting narrative possibilities. Director Josh Cooley's experience with blending emotional storytelling and animated worlds in *Toy Story 4* suggests a strong creative vision for this project. The Lego Group has consistently demonstrated a capacity for meta-commentary and heartfelt narratives within their toy-centric stories, and with Reeves potentially leading the charge, this film could offer a unique blend of action, humor, and character-driven drama that appeals to both long-time fans and newcomers.

## What Fans Are Saying

News of Keanu Reeves' potential involvement has, predictably, sent waves of excitement through fan communities. The actor's widespread appeal, coupled with his recent successes and his established persona as a thoughtful performer, makes him an intriguing choice for a Lego film. Fans are already buzzing with theories about his character, with many hoping for a role that plays to his strengths in action or perhaps offers a surprising comedic turn. The prospect of seeing Reeves interact with the whimsical, blocky world of Lego has generated considerable anticipation, with many eager to see how this collaboration will unfold and what new stories will be built.

## What's Next

While Keanu Reeves' casting is not yet official, fans will be watching closely for further announcements regarding the project's development. The film is anticipated for a 2026 release, and more details about the story, supporting cast, and the specific nature of Reeves' role are expected to emerge as negotiations conclude and production begins.

tr.title: Keanu Reeves Yeni Lego Filminde Oynayacak: Bilinenler
tr.summary: Sevilen aktör, Universal'in yeni bir Lego filmi için görüşmelerde. Bu proje, Reeves'in tamamen yeni bir plastik dünyaya adım atmasını sağlayabilir. 2026 yılında vizyona girmesi beklenen film, canlı çekim ve animasyonun birleşmesiyle ortaya çıkacak.
tr.body:
## Yeni Bir Lego Macerası Başlıyor

Keanu Reeves'in yeni bir **Lego** filmi için görüşmelerde olduğu söyleniyor. **Josh Cooley** tarafından yönetilecek olan bu proje, 2026 yılında vizyona girmesi planlanıyor. Universal Pictures ve The Lego Group arasındaki yeni anlaşmanın ilk filmi olacak ve canlı çekim ile animasyonun birleşmesiyle ortaya çıkacak.

Reeves, yakın zamanda *Toy Story 5*'te again **Duke Caboom** karakterine hayat verdi. Bu filmde de benzer bir rolü üstlenebilir. Filmin detayları henüz bilinmese de, Reeves'in filmde merkezi bir karakter olacağı ve ya canlı çekimle ya da animasyon olarak görüneceği söyleniyor. Stüdyo, Reeves'i bu yeni **Lego** sinematik evreninin merkezine koymak istiyor.

## Lego'nun Yeni Çağı

Bu yeni girişim, **Lego** filmleri için yeni bir sayfa açıyor. Daha önce Warner Bros. ile birlikte *The Lego Movie* gibi büyük başarılar elde edilen **Lego** filmleri, şimdi Universal ile birlikte farklı bir yaklaşımla devam edecek. Canlı çekim ve animasyonun birleşmesi, heyecan verici anlatı olanakları sunuyor. Yönetmen **Josh Cooley**, *Toy Story 4*'te emocional hikayeler ve animasyon dünyalarını birleştirmesiyle deneyim sahibi. **The Lego Group**, oyuncak merkezli hikayelerinde meta-yorum ve samimi anlatılar sunma kapasitesini gösterdi. Reeves'in potansiyel katılımı, aksiyon, komedi ve karakter odaklı dramın benzersiz bir birleşimini sunabilir.

## Hayranların Tepkisi

Keanu Reeves'in potansiyel katılımı haberleri, doğal olarak hayran topluluklarında heyecan dalgaları yaratmış durumda. Aktörün geniş kapsamlı çekiciliği, recent başarıları ve düşünceli bir performansçı olarak kurulmuş kişiliği, onu bir **Lego** filmi için ilginç bir seçim haline getiriyor. Hayranlar, already karakteri hakkında teoriler üreterek, either aksiyon veya belki de komik bir rolde görünebileceğini umuyorlar. Reeves'in fantastik, bloklardan oluşan **Lego** dünyasıyla etkileşime gireceği fikri, önemli bir beklenti yaratmış durumda ve birçok kişi bu işbirliğinin nasıl şekilleneceğini ve yeni hikayelerin nasıl inşa edileceğini görmek için sabırsızlanıyor.

## Sonraki Adımlar

Keanu Reeves'in kadroya katılması resmi olarak açıklanmasa da, hayranlar projenin gelişimini yakından takip edecekler. 2026 yılında vizyona girmesi beklenen film hakkında, hikaye, yardımcı kadro ve Reeves'in rolü hakkında daha fazla detay, görüşmelerin tamamlanması ve prodüksiyonun başlamasıyla ortaya çıkması bekleniyor.

content_raw: News Keanu Reeves Keanu Reeves in Talks to Star in Lego Live-Action Hybrid Movie But will Reeves be a minifig? By Vanessa Armstrong | Published on June 22, 2026 Screenshot: Lionsgate Comment 0 Share New Share Screenshot: Lionsgate Keanu Reeves (pictured above as an angel in 2025’s Good Fortune ) recently reprised his voice for the character Duke Caboom in Toy Story 5 , and the actor is eyeing another movie that will include animation and toys as main characters. The movie in question is a Lego feature at Universal that will contain a mix of animation and live action. According to Deadline , Reeves is in talks to star in such a film with Josh Cooley, who wrote and directed Toy Story 4 , at the helm. The project is the first in a deal Universal signed with The Lego Group to create three live-action films based on the plastic building blocks. It’s not clear whether Reeves will be lending his voice to a Lego character or if his entire body will be on screen for live-action acting. What we do know, according to Deadline , is that the movie will revolve around Reeves’ character, whatever form that may take, and that the studio is courting him to be the centerpiece of a Lego feature. Reeves is reportedly warming up to the idea. Other than that, details are slim! That doesn’t mean we can’t conjecture: Will Reeves be playing a John Wick-esque dude with crazy fighting skills? Or will he be more like his Toy Story character, the Canadian daredevil Duke Caboom? Or perhaps (probably) will he play a completely different character? Who knows! What we do know is that any Lego movie that comes to pass will be the latest installment in a burgeoning franchise that started with 2014’s animated feature, The Lego Movie . Those films came out at Warner Bros., and this live-action/animation movie from Universal appears to be a different iteration on the IP. Fingers crossed we’ll get more news about the Keanu Reeves Lego film soon, including who Reeves will be playing (assuming, of course, that the deal moves forward).[end-mark] The post Keanu Reeves in Talks to Star in Lego Live-Action Hybrid Movie appeared first on Reactor .
